text:
sophie: Hey team  need a tiny manager-facing checklist for a hybrid PM starting Mon. One page, DM-ready, plus a copy-paste 30/60/90 with measurable bullets. Can we finalize today?
luke: I trimmed our long packet to a 6-bullet day0-7 list + 30/60/90. Keeps it manager-only (no hire-facing details except a short day0 DM).
jamal: IT notes to include: imaging window Fri 5pm or Mon 810am, image tag `rwi-onboard-2026-v3`. Badge/QR pickup windows: Mon 8:30-10:30 & Tue 15:00-16:00. Add a small IT snippet managers can paste:```
Provision request:
name: {name}
email: {email}
os: mac|linux
teams: product,pm
image: rwi-onboard-2026-v3
tools: slack,github,notion,okta
```
sophie: Perfect. Keep these manager-only tasks: confirm pickup vs shipping, assign buddy, schedule Day1 30-min setup with IT, schedule tech tour by Day3, set 30-day success criteria, schedule week4 skip-level.
luke: Day-by-day bullets (one-liners managers can tick):
- Before start: complete intake (shipping address, in-office days, OS)
- Day0: DM new hire with pickup options + parking/QR info
- Day1: 09:00-09:30 Welcome + IT setup (Manager + IT + Buddy)
- Day2-3: permissions + repo access; tech walkthrough
- Day4-5: first small scoped task; week1 30-min check-in
- End of week: record 30-day goals in Notion

luke: Copyable 30/60/90 (manager version):
- 30 days: merge 2 small PRs, deploy a tiny change to staging with guidance, complete security & SSO setup, present a 30-day learning plan.
- 60 days: own one feature area end-to-end, deliver medium scope task, reduce PR review turnaround in owned area by 10%.
- 90 days: lead a minor rollout, mentor buddy on onboarding tasks, propose one measurable process improvement accepted by team.
sophie: Add DM templates managers can send Day0 and Day1. Day0 (short):
"Hi <name>  excited to have you! Pickup laptop Mon 9-11am (Bldg A reception) or we can ship. Reply with preference. Bring photo ID for badge. First day 9am: quick setup with IT + 30-min intro with me.  <manager>"

rita: Also include manager-only admin checklist: request GitHub org access within 24h, confirm analytics DB groups, add to Notion team page, request any ergonomic stipend within first 2 weeks.
onboard-bot: Reminder: intake form triggers SSO/security training invites and auto-enrolls new hires to #new-hires when manager completes it. Action items created: (1) Publish one-pager -> sophie, (2) Add pickup/shipping & OS fields to intake -> people-ops, (3) Share calendar ICS bundle -> luke. Due: today 4:30pm.
